corrections.text: The article quotes OpenRouter's model listing as stating the model listing "states plainly that 'the stealth model \"Ox Alpha\" was revealed to be GLM-5.3 Flash.'" OpenRouter's actual FAQ text reads: "Yes, the stealth model Ox Alpha was revealed to be ZAI's new model, GLM-5.3 Flash." The quoted passage silently omits "ZAI's new model," from the middle of the source sentence without an ellipsis. The underlying fact is unaffected — OpenRouter does confirm Ox Alpha was GLM-5.3-Flash — but the quotation as printed is not verbatim.
